title: Would They Be Afraid of Us?

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A child wonders whether distant people, if they ever met Isolans, would be frightened of them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a child, wonders whether distant people, if they ever met Isolans, would be frightened of them.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child is surprised that anyone could be afraid of Isolans, and an elder explains that unfamiliar things can frighten anyone.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A scholar points out that Isolans might be frightened too.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child imagines distant children asking a thousand questions, just as Isolan children would.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A teenager imagines trading songs and stories.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village decides that smiles and shared food might help anywhere.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An elder says that patience matters more than any gift.
